title: skill.yaml
description: A skill the model can call as a tool (ADR-0005). `prompt` and `tool_chain` skills need no code; `builtin` skills are Rust handlers registered by id.

description.description: Shown to the model as the tool description; say when to use it.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema of the tool arguments.

prompt.description: Required for `kind: prompt`. Input fields are the template variables.

model_slot.description: Agent slot that runs a `prompt` skill (default `primary`).

steps.description: Required for `kind: tool_chain`. Argument strings may use `{input.<field>}` and `{steps.<n>.output}`.
